messages:
Maria: Heads-up team — were doing the orders.customer_metadata backfill tonight. Quiet-window reserved 02:00 UTC. Need a coordinator for the dual-write/cutover checklist and someone to own smoke tests. Who's up? :wave:
Ajay: I can coordinate. I'll be online 01:0004:00 UTC and can lead the cutover. Please drop the exact timeline and rollback details here.
Maria: Thanks. High-level timeline: prefill chunks start 01:30 UTC (background), enable dual-write at 02:00 UTC for 30m, run smoke sequence at 02:35, evaluate and flip read traffic at 02:45 if green, monitor for 60m. If we see anomalies, rollback reads and keep dual-write while we debug.
Sam: I'll own the smoke suite and dashboards. Planning to add a quick CI job that runs our sanity checks and posts results. What checks do we want?
Maria: Smoke checklist: - create_order path verifies customer_metadata saved - read path returns customer_metadata consistently - p95 query latency < 200ms - no NULL customer_id for newly created orders after 10s
Sam: Got it. I'll add these assertions and the expected ranges. Adding the smoke command to runbook: ```bash
# run smoke checks
python infra/smoke_tests.py --env prod --checks create,read,latency --timeout 120
```
Devon: Rollback specifics please. Need exact traffic-switch commands and who confirms each step.
Ajay: Rollback plan (concise): 1) Switch read routing back to v1 schema: `svc-router set-route orders.read v1` 2) Keep dual-write active for 15m to capture writes to both schemas 3) Run validation: `scripts/validate_backfill.py --since now-30m` 4) If validation passes, schedule a corrective backfill; else escalate to infra. I'll paste runnable commands in runbook.
Maria: Backfill notes: chunked updates, no table locks. We'll pause if replica lag > 5s. Backfill job respects replication lag probe and will sleep between chunks.
Sam: Adding an alert for replica lag > 5s and a Slack notification to this thread. Also will add a dashboard panel for write amplification.
Ajay: Secondary contact? If I'm paged and don't respond, who's the fallback?
Devon: I can be second contact 01:3004:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: Quiet-window confirmed 02:0004:00 UTC (reservation id: qw-175901). Reminder: tag PRs with #quiet-window and include runbook link.
Maria: DB backups completed 23:50 UTC, WAL archiving verified. Can someone confirm they've set their Slack status to the oncall/quiet-window mode?
Ajay: Status updated. I'll be in the channel during prefill and cutover.
Sam: Runbook stub: https://go/runbooks/orders-customer-metadata-backfill — adding smoke job and expected outputs now.
Maria: Final: starting prefill at 01:30 if no objections. If replication lag spikes or smoke failures happen we keep dual-write and roll reads back.
Devon: No objections from infra. Logging will be retained for 48h.
Ajay: All set. I'll post a short checklist when prefill starts. :eyes:
